title: V01-C10 Conditional Execution Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A reviewed decision table whose feasible rule columns are implemented as complete, ordered, mutually understandable conditional branches.
A branch-to-input map that reaches every intended outcome and identifies missing or unreachable branches without claiming coverage proves correctness.

accessibility_requirements: Decision tables have labeled condition, rule, and action headers.
Flow diagrams have equivalent text traces.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: Broad branches may shadow special cases.
Truthy/falsy conditions may hide invalid data.
Dangling else and missing braces may mislead readers.
Switch fall-through may be introduced outside the Chapter need.
Coverage may be confused with correctness.
